mentions.name: The Little Book of Algorithms
mentions.description: This book project implements 1,000 algorithms as a learning resource, with around 400 finished so far. It pairs implementations in Python and C with test cases and formal proofs written in Lean, with the long-term goal of being a solid reference covering correctness, performance, and theory in one place. The project is currently in draft phase and will be heavily edited as it grows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on the little book of algorithms:
https://github.com/little-book-of/algorithms

A project to implement 1000 algorithms. I have finished around 400 so far and I am now focusing on adding test cases, writing implementations in Python and C, and creating formal proofs in Lean.
